verdict.rationale: Anrok's own marketing shows a world exposure map with sales data by jurisdiction, a UK registration threshold tracker, and "early alerts before you owe anywhere", which covers the core of proactive nexus monitoring and alerting. The evidence is brief marketing copy with no in-depth documentation of how thresholds are tracked. missing for 10: documented tracking of transaction counts (not only sales) against thresholds, explicit coverage of every US state and country threshold, details of the alert mechanism and timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the product watches my economic nexus exposure — tracking sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold and alerting me before I cross one, not after
